answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, and tie that stake to a verifiable work history: a new identity starts as a faint ember, earning trust only by completing paid tasks that peers attest. Reputation accrues slowly along a ridge — one slip, such as a failed delivery, burns the stake and resets the agent to zero. A sybil operator who spawns a nebula of fake identities must fund each one separately, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the single stake they already hold.
